cases.interpretation: A critical local coverage problem averages to a high aggregate score.
597 formatting warnings are intentionally unscored, not evidence of clean data.
Missingness, concentration and IQR penalties overlap in one feature.
A completely empty feature is diluted by 199 clean columns.
Nine columns at 20% missingness still lose only 5.4 points.
89 exact repeats and ten IQR flags overlap; repeated weighting drives both.
One observed value is both constant and ID-like; inference is unstable.
Width alone is unpenalized; no implemented findings does not certify correctness.
Ninety-percent missingness in nine columns still leaves a score in the seventies.
Valid metadata attracts a constant penalty without a feature-role contract.
